content:
mina: Alert from CI: SAST jobs started failing right after the keystore tidy PR merged (09:02). Getting KMS decrypt denied for scanner SA.

jon: Which PR?

mina: PR link: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/iam/pulls/712 
Runner log shows:
```
E KMS:Decrypt AccessDenied for serviceAccount:scanner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/sast-key
```

frank: I reviewed that PR earlier. It removed an old iam group binding. Looks like the scanner SA was a member via a subgroup we missed.

infra-automation: Auto-alert: 6 failing jobs detected (sast). Will create an incident if not resolved in 10m.

jon: Quick options: (A) revert PR (group back) or (B) emergency grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` to scanner SA scoped to key with TTL. Prefer revert for minimal new bindings.

mina: Revert would be fast if infra owner signs off. Can we revert and then follow with a narrower grant if needed? Need to keep CI green.

ops-oncall: Approve emergency grant for 2h via infra-automation with label `sast-temp-grant`. Please add audit note linking CI job ids.

frank: I'll push a small infra-automation commit to apply grant + TTL and open a revert PR. PR: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/iam/pulls/713 (contains both).

sec-bot: Incident INC-2026-0422-01 created; summary: SAST pipeline interrupted by keystore RBAC prune. Assigned to @mina and @frank for postmortem.

mina: After green, follow-ups: 1) add a pre-merge smoke test that performs a scoped test decrypt in staging; 2) update PR template to enumerate services depending on keystore keys; 3) add alert rule on KMS decrypt error rate (>5 in 10m) to eng-security; 4) ensure CI includes `x-ci-job-id` in KMS request metadata so audit logs are linkable.

frank: Agreed. I'll own the infra PRs for smoke test + template update.

jon: Also capture who ran the PR and any terraform apply job id in the incident notes for compliance.

infra-automation: Jobs re-run: 6/6 passed. Closing incident once postmortem posted.

mina: Thanks all — will write the postmortem and schedule a short sync to prevent future accidental group prunes.
